hwsim: Explicit three-way merge from old path at merge base and LTS into renamed source; retains exact TX-info length policy, stop/RX mutex serialization, pending skb dequeue loop, virtio length clamp. Retain LTS NAN flag-or-iftype honoring alongside ACK multi-radio rejection.
rationale: SDK virtio audio/storage and ordinary QEMU/KVM guest do not require physical UFS/SDCA amplifier/Mediatek SoC or protected-host device-assignment headers. These excluded headers had no corresponding ported providers. Keep LTS device probe-readiness and atomic fwnode flags; these are correctness fixes, not historical layout to preserve. Page-size emulation is an Android SDK x86 runtime facility, unlike the excluded protected-host extensions.
